public_rationale: The report published on February 10, 2026 describes Aletheia generating all mathematical content of an eigenweights paper without human intervention [e1]. It does not establish that a new autonomous proof comparable in significance to the Robbins conjecture emerged in the immediate aftermath of the July 2025 IMO results [e1]. It also does not provide a comprehensive record establishing the absence of such a proof during that period [e1]. The report therefore settles neither side of this forecast [e1].
limitations: “Immediately” has no operational endpoint; open_horizon does not extend it indefinitely.
The report's publication date does not establish when the proof was completed.
The packet lacks an independent comparison of the result's significance with Robbins.
This assessment does not establish the background assertion that Robbins was the only earlier qualifying theorem.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Tying for 27th place at the IMO will not immediately change the fact that only one theorem of middling importance (the Robbins conjecture, in 1996) has ever been proved autonomously by an AI system.

statement.excerpt: Tying for 27th place in a highly elite high school mathematics competition will not immediately change that.
statement.document_title: DeepMind and OpenAI achieve IMO Gold. What does it all mean?

from_speaker: only one theorem of middling importance

our_interpretation: The forecast concerns a new autonomous research proof of significance comparable to the Robbins conjecture in the immediate aftermath of the July 2025 IMO results.
Human selection of a problem and subsequent verification do not disqualify autonomy; human provision of essential proof steps does.
Immediately supplies no defensible numerical deadline. I do not substitute the evaluation date, or a fixed number of months, for it.
The historical assertion about Robbins is background to this forecast, not a separately graded claim.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive, independently assessed record establishes that no qualifying autonomous proof emerged during an agreed interpretation of the immediate aftermath.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A dated, independently verified autonomous proof of a new theorem of comparable or greater significance emerged in the immediate aftermath of the IMO results.
